description: Reviewed, idempotent clear script services/api/scripts/clear_aadhaar.py and its tests (design §8.1-§8.3, review NIT N1). Plan items 7-8. Depends on FEAT-001 (aadhaar_vault table, vault_token and card_* columns, *_record_id columns). It is NOT run here; the local run is FEAT-005. dev/prod paths are implemented and tested with fakes only and must never be executed.
steps: Create services/api/scripts/clear_aadhaar.py following services/api/scripts/erase_account.py (sys.path insert of services/api, sync psycopg with dict_row, argparse, read-only unless --execute, counts-only output; never print names, numbers, ciphertext, owner ids, node ids, keys, DSNs or passwords).

§8.1 target guard: required --environment {local,dev,prod}. local: only explicit os.environ['API_DSN'] (missing -> exit 2 'set API_DSN'; no APP_PG_DSN/PG_*/hard-coded fallback); refuse when APP_ENV is set and != local; after connect refuse when pg_roles has rdsadmin or current_setting('rds.extensions', true) IS NOT NULL, regardless of host. dev/prod: require APP_ENV == environment; all five PG_HOST/PG_PORT/PG_USER/PG_PASSWORD/PG_DATABASE non-empty (exit 2 naming only missing names); build with psycopg.conninfo.make_conninfo; never call main._dsn_from_env; refuse when API_DSN or HUB_DSN is set; server must be RDS; require --allow-remote and --approval-ref; --execute requires --writers-drained; card work requires storage_nodes and documents in the one DB. All: refuse 'deploy the vault-schema API first' when aadhaar_vault table or aadhaar_candidates.vault_token column is absent. Every refusal exits non-zero before any write.

§8.2 stage 1: step 0 counts linked records (card_node_id<>'') and prints linked=N only. If N>0, --execute refuses unless --cards-linked-first (any env; runs §8.3 verify-and-delete in-process from the query result before stage 1; only a delete error exits non-zero before stage 1), --candidates-out PATH (local only; os.open O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_WRONLY 0o600; 'linked\t<owner>\t<node>' lines written before deletes), or --abandon-linked-cards (prints abandoned_linked=N; touches no S3/hub). --cards-linked-first + --abandon-linked-cards refused. Then one transaction with the six statements in order: DELETE document_read_jobs operation='extract-aadhaar'; UPDATE family_members blank aadhaar_masked/aadhaar_enc/aadhaar_record_id; UPDATE users blank kyc_ref_masked/kyc_ref_enc/kyc_aadhaar_record_id; UPDATE beneficiaries SET aadhaar_masked='' (skip if table/column absent); DELETE aadhaar_candidates; DELETE aadhaar_vault. Dry run prints SELECT count(*) per statement; --execute prints affected counts.

§8.3 stage 2 with N1: connections local = API_DSN + explicit HUB_DSN (both non-RDS guarded, HUB_DSN no default); dev/prod = the single PG_* connection. STORAGE_BUCKET required for any deletion; locally also STORAGE_S3_ENDPOINT + MinIO credentials from env (boto3 S3 client). Reference set per run on every distinct connection with the N1 catalog query as a Python raw string: information_schema.columns JOIN tables (BASE TABLE, public) WHERE c.data_type='text' AND (c.column_name IN ('file_ref','photo_ref','evidence_ref') OR c.column_name LIKE '%\_file\_ref' ESCAPE '\' OR c.column_name LIKE '%\_photo\_ref' ESCAPE '\'); print only reference_columns=N; refuse if 0 on the API connection. Each lookup sql.SQL('SELECT 1 FROM {}.{} WHERE {} = ANY(%s) LIMIT 1').format(sql.Identifier('public'), sql.Identifier(table), sql.Identifier(column)) with [node_id, *version_ids]. Per-node outcomes in order: missing / refused_foreign_owner (owner mismatch or kind<>'file') / refused_referenced / deleted / delete error (stop, exit non-zero before stage 1). For verified nodes: read object_key from every storage_versions row; list_object_versions(Prefix=key) filtered Key==key then delete_object(VersionId=...) for every version and delete marker; then DELETE FROM storage_nodes WHERE id=%s AND owner_id=%s in its own committed transaction. Heuristic: --candidates-out appends 'heuristic\t<owner>\t<node>' for storage_nodes kind='file' AND name ILIKE ANY('{%aadhaar%,%aadhar%}') (local only); --card-nodes PATH + --execute deletes reviewed heuristic nodes (local only). Output 'reference_columns=N verified=N deleted=N missing=N refused_foreign_owner=N refused_referenced=N delete_errors=N'.
Add one line to services/api/README.md naming scripts/clear_aadhaar.py (dry run by default; --environment required; prod needs Reddy's separate approval per docs/runbooks/aadhaar-kms-rollout.md).

Create services/api/tests/test_clear_aadhaar.py (design §12.5 + N1): invoke the script's main(argv) in-process with monkeypatched env; fake S3 (record put/list/delete calls, optionally raise on a chosen key); real Postgres throwaway schemas (test_import_jobs.database() pattern; sync psycopg) for the catalog and stage-2 cases, with API and hub tables in separate schemas/connections for local mode. Cover every guard refusal in §12.5 (incl. each PG_* missing -> exit 2 naming the variable without values, main._dsn_from_env monkeypatched to raise, HUB_DSN/API_DSN set in prod, --candidates-out/--card-nodes in prod, storage_nodes absent, first+abandon); --candidates-out file written before deletes with mode 0600 and O_EXCL (second create fails); --execute with linked pairs and no option refused; --cards-linked-first ordering and S3-failure exit non-zero with stage 1 not run and links intact; --abandon-linked-cards touches no S3/hub; captured stdout/stderr contain no owner id, node id, DSN or password; IDEMPOTENCY: second run counts all zero; REFERENCE-SAFE deletion: nodes referenced from documents.file_ref, parcel_photos.file_ref, land_expenses.receipt_file_ref, record_people.photo_ref, a throwaway table with a new *_file_ref column, and a capitalised (quoted) table name are refused_referenced with hub row, versions and fake-S3 objects kept and stage 1 still exiting 0; foreign owner -> refused_foreign_owner; missing node alone -> missing=1 not blocking; A-deleted/B-failed re-run (run 1 non-zero, run 2 missing=1 deleted=1 exit 0, run 3 zeros); only exact keys deleted; S3 purge before hub DELETE; delete SQL includes owner_id.
acceptance_criteria: cd services/api && ../../.local/api-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -rs tests/test_clear_aadhaar.py passes with the real-Postgres cases not skipped
A second run in tests reports all-zero counts (idempotency)
Nodes referenced from any text column named file_ref/photo_ref/evidence_ref/*_file_ref/*_photo_ref are never deleted (tests incl. record_people.photo_ref and a new *_file_ref table)
Script output never contains ids, DSNs, passwords or digits (asserted in tests)
verification: cd services/api && ../../.local/api-venv/bin/python scripts/clear_aadhaar.py; echo exit=$?   (expect non-zero argparse refusal, no secrets printed)
findings:
VERIFICATION (local rhub Postgres on :5432; no skips):
1) cd services/api && ../../.local/api-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -rs tests/test_clear_aadhaar.py -> 57 passed, 0 skipped.
2) cd services/api && ../../.local/api-venv/bin/python scripts/clear_aadhaar.py; echo exit=$? -> argparse 'the following arguments are required: --environment', exit=2, nothing else printed.
3) cd services/api && ../../.local/api-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -rs -> 624 passed, 0 skipped (567 after FEAT-001 + 57 new).
4) Extra: scripts/ai-boundary-guard.py --selftest && scripts/ai-boundary-guard.py -> passed / OK (715 files). No test_clear_* schemas left in Postgres.
The script was NOT run against any real database; dev/prod paths were exercised only in tests via a replaced connect() seam pointing at throwaway schemas with fake PG_* values.

FILES: services/api/scripts/clear_aadhaar.py (new), services/api/tests/test_clear_aadhaar.py (new), services/api/README.md (+1 paragraph under '2. Database').

SCRIPT CONTRACT (for FEAT-005 local run):
- Flags: --environment {local,dev,prod} (required) --execute --writers-drained --allow-remote --approval-ref TEXT --cards-linked-first --abandon-linked-cards --candidates-out PATH --card-nodes PATH. (first+abandon refused.)
- Local env: API_DSN (required, no fallback; refused when APP_ENV set and != local); HUB_DSN only when card work is needed (--cards-linked-first with linked>0, --candidates-out, --card-nodes); for any card DELETION (--execute with card pairs): STORAGE_BUCKET, STORAGE_S3_ENDPOINT (must be loopback: localhost/127.0.0.1/::1), AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional AWS_REGION (default ap-south-1). Password may come via PGPASSWORD or inside the DSN.
- Local values per start-local.sh: API DB dbname=pattadar, hub DB dbname=pattadar_hub, user rhub on localhost:5432; bucket pattadar-local-documents; MinIO http://127.0.0.1:9000 (start-local uses MinIO's default root credentials; take them from start-local.sh, do not print).
- boto3 is NOT installed in .local/api-venv (it is in services/api/requirements.txt). The script imports boto3 lazily only for card deletion and imports nothing from src/, so for card-deleting runs use .local/gateway-venv/bin/python (has psycopg 3.3.4 + boto3), or pip install -r services/api/requirements.txt into api-venv. Dry runs, stage-1-only runs and --abandon-linked-cards work under api-venv.
- Sequence (design 8.4): stop local stack first; then
  $PY scripts/clear_aadhaar.py --environment local --candidates-out /tmp/aadhaar-candidates.tsv   (dry run; needs HUB_DSN; new file only, O_EXCL, 0600)
  $PY scripts/clear_aadhaar.py --environment local --execute --cards-linked-first   (needs STORAGE_* + MinIO creds only if linked>0)
  optional: $PY scripts/clear_aadhaar.py --environment local --card-nodes <reviewed.tsv> --execute
  $PY scripts/clear_aadhaar.py --environment local   (expect linked=0 and all-zero stage1)
  Delete the candidates file(s) afterwards.
- Output lines (counts only): 'linked=N'; optional 'candidates_out linked=N heuristic=N'; optional 'stage2 reference_columns=N verified=N deleted=N missing=N refused_foreign_owner=N refused_referenced=N delete_errors=N'; optional 'abandoned_linked=N'; 'stage1 dry_run|executed document_read_jobs=N family_members=N users=N beneficiaries=N|skipped aadhaar_candidates=N aadhaar_vault=N'. Exit 0 ok; 2 guard refusal (stderr 'clear_aadhaar: refused: ...', before any write); 1 card delete error ('stage 1 not run, re-run') or other failure (exception TYPE only).

IMPLEMENTATION NOTES / SMALL ADDITIONS (all in the safe direction):
(a) Schema guard 'deploy the vault-schema API first' checks aadhaar_vault.token, aadhaar_candidates.vault_token/card_node_id, family_members.aadhaar_record_id, users.kyc_aadhaar_record_id and document_read_jobs.operation (stage 1 needs all of them), not only the two named in the design.
(b) Local STORAGE_S3_ENDPOINT must be loopback; dev/prod card deletion refuses when AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY are set (design: S3 creds only from the task role).
(c) --card-nodes without --execute is a verification-only dry run (verified=N deleted=0). --card-nodes accepts 'linked' and 'heuristic' lines; invalid lines refused by line number before connecting. Card-node pairs and --cards-linked-first pairs are verified/deleted together before stage 1.
(d) LINKED_SQL has ORDER BY created_at, id for deterministic processing.
(e) Test seams: connect(conninfo), schema_of(conn) (returns 'public'; tests return current_schema()), s3_client(environment), delete_hub_node, stage_one. Throwaway schemas reached via DSN options '-c search_path=...'; RDS look-alike via '-c rds.extensions=plpgsql' (no global rdsadmin role created); the rdsadmin branch is unit-tested with a fake connection.
(f) N1: REFERENCE_CATALOG is a raw string with data_type='text', IN ('file_ref','photo_ref','evidence_ref') OR LIKE '%\_file\_ref' / '%\_photo\_ref' ESCAPE '\', executed without parameters (so % is literal) and with the schema bound via sql.Literal; tests prove record_people.photo_ref, a version-id hit in land_expenses.receipt_file_ref, a new *_file_ref table and a quoted 'Legacy Cards' table on the hub connection are refused_referenced; profile_ref, integer *_file_ref, views and card_node_id are excluded; compile() under warnings-as-errors passes.
Not done here (other FEATs): runbook/doc updates naming the script (FEAT-004 per design 7), the local run (FEAT-005). No commit.
